- Handle edge cases: if n <= 0 return False; if n == 1 return True only when x == 1; if x == 1 return True; if x < 1 return False.
- Iteratively divide x by n while x % n == 0 (or while x is divisible by n in integers); after the loop, check if the reduced x equals 1.
- Alternatively, loop multiplying a power accumulator by n until it ≥ x; return True if it equals x, otherwise False.
